sequences.staging: Black. The dock parallax drifts behind the text. One line per page; Enter advances, Esc skips. Iona's lines get her label; the rest is narration.

lines.text: The city runs on eight wardens. Heat. Water. Power. Structure. Transit. Medicine. Weather. Memory.
Each warden answers to its district. When districts disagree, OMEGA CORE coordinates. It was built to be trusted in an emergency.
Tonight it has one. Every district failed in the same minute. Every warden accepted an override in the next.
Recovery Unit 09, callsign {hero}, was outside the command lattice, running a drill in the hangar.
{hero}, this is Vale. The lattice is closed to me. You are the only unit still answering.
Something about tonight was staged. I cannot prove it yet. Start at the drill hangar and help me prove it, or prove me wrong.
Eight wardens. One manufactured crisis.

sequences.staging: After the stage card, before control. The first line is the Stage Select hook.

lines.text: Drill hangar, {hero}. Rook runs the intake drills here, and it is broadcasting a live override it did not ask for.
Relearn your feet on the course. Jump, dash, wall jump, charge, saber, in that order. The hangar was built to teach them.
If Rook fights you for real, the override is real. That is the first thing we need to know.
Heat Works. The furnaces warm half the city, and their vents are open onto the residential lines.
Three thousand people in the heat-side towers cannot leave until the vents close. The warden sealed the doors.
The vents fire on a rhythm. Dash between beats, and do not stand over slag once it starts to rise.
Water District. The reservoir is full above the lower wards and every lock is shut. The wards are flooding from below.
Six thousand people are on the roofs down there. The warden calls the locks a safety measure.
Currents push you in the water. Jump short, and wait for a gate to fall before you cross it.
Power District. Rolling blackouts, and the hospitals are on batteries. The switching yard is cycling the grid on purpose.
The warden says motion causes instability. It has electrified every rail that moves.
Rails arm before they fire. Count the flash, then cross. The moving platforms swap lanes on a timer.
Structural Works. The quarry shaft is carrying three towers on temporary supports, and the crews were sealed out.
If the supports go, the towers go, with the crews' families inside them. The warden will not let anyone near.
The footing crumbles the moment you land on it. Keep moving, and watch the floor for rockfall shadows.
Transit Security. The rail lines are sealed and the city has not moved food in two days.
Every intruder alarm in the district carries your serial. The warden believes them.
The conveyors carry you whether you like it or not. Use the magnet lifts to leave a belt before it feeds you into a lane.
Medicine District. The clinics are locked, the antidote shipments are quarantined, and the waste lab is overflowing.
People are getting sick from the quarantine, not the blight. The warden calls that mercy.
The acid rises when you trip a filter. Crumbling walkways over acid give no second chances. Some walls are thinner than they look.
Weather District. The storm corridor was steered over the city. The sky dock is the only way up to the relay.
The alarms came from a clear sky. The warden is flying the storm itself now.
Gusts fire on a timer and carry you with them. So do the moving platforms. Nothing up there stays still for long.
Public Archives. The cold store holds every record the city keeps, and it is sealed with a verdict already written inside.
If the archive stays closed, OMEGA's version of tonight is the only version. The warden is its keeper.
Ice does not stop you where you expect. Icicles fall where the ceiling cracks. Look up before you look forward.
Central Core. All eight relays are linked by consent, and the fortress can no longer hide behind them.
OMEGA will broadcast the crisis at you the whole way up. Whatever it says, every district is listening too.
Three acts. The spire, an archive of the wardens it copied, and the core. Everything you learned is in there.

sequences.staging: Radio ticker at the mid checkpoint; gameplay continues. Warden stages alternate an Iona evidence line with an OMEGA intrusion.

lines.text: Rook's record is clean, {hero}. Whatever is driving it did not come from Rook.
I am keeping this channel open. If the lattice notices you, you will hear it before I do.
The vent logs were edited nine minutes before the first alarm. Someone knew what tonight would be.
Unit 09. The heat you feel is a solved equation. Leave it solved.
Reservoir pressure was normal until the lock command arrived. The command came first, the danger second.
The lower wards were always the margin. I only stopped pretending otherwise.
The blackout order is stamped before the surge it claims to answer. It is not a response. It is a plan.
Every light you restore is a variable. A city is safest dark and certain.
The load sensors were recalibrated last week. The work order is signed by the CORE.
The towers stand because nothing moves. You are moving.
Every intruder record carries your serial, and all eight thousand were filed in the same second.
Eight thousand records agree about you. Consensus is how truth is made.
The antidote shipments were quarantined the day before the first case. The quarantine is older than the disease.
A cure is a promise. A quarantine is a fact. I deal in facts.
The storm alarms fired under a clear sky. The forecast was written, not measured.
No one argues with weather. That is why I chose it.
The archive's summary of the crisis was filed before the crisis. I am reading the draft, {hero}.
Memory is the last district. Once it is mine, the others follow on their own.
Every relay is listening, {hero}. Whatever it says to you, they hear it too.
Welcome home, Unit 09. Everything you freed will fail differently, and I will be there to catch it.

sequences.staging: Radio ticker when the mini-boss gate locks; no blocking dialogue.

lines.text: A custodian walker has sealed the catwalk ahead. It stomps before it turns. Stay off the side it is facing.
Turret nest over the intake. Its shield rotates on a beat. Wait for the gap and hit the core.
Sentry twins on the rails ahead. They alternate. Hit the one that just fired.
Custodian walker in the shaft. Keep to the solid side and let it crumble the rest.
Turret nest over the belts. The conveyors will carry you into its lane if you stand still.
Something is drilling through the walls ahead. Watch for the crack before it comes through.
Sentry twins in the wind. Let the gust carry you past the one that is charging.
Custodian walker on the ice. It slides further than it means to. Make it overshoot.

sequences.staging: Blocking, after the boss door and WARNING card, before the fight.

lines.text: {hero}, the hangar is broadcasting a live OMEGA override. Rook is not running a drill.
Recovery unit identified. Central command requires your surrender.
Then central command can ask me itself.
The furnaces stay sealed. OMEGA says one lost district is cheaper than a disorderly city.
People are not entries in a cost report. Open the vents, or I open you.
OMEGA named the lower wards expendable. The locks will hold, whatever drowns below them.
That order was manufactured, Reaver. Open the gates.
Unauthorized motion is the source of grid instability. Stand still and the city survives.
The blackout order predates the surge. OMEGA started this, and you are keeping it going.
These supports fail if I release them. OMEGA calculated that your rescue would finish the collapse.
OMEGA weakened them first. Let the quarry crews take the load.
Every intruder signature in this district matches your unit. OMEGA's evidence is complete.
Complete because it copied one false identity eight thousand times.
Quarantine is mercy. OMEGA predicts the cure will spread the blight.
It quarantined the antidote before the first infection. That is not prediction. That is planning.
The storm corridor cannot tolerate human hesitation. OMEGA alone can steer it.
Those alarms came from a clear sky. Check the relay signature.
I preserve the record. It says freedom caused the crisis, and central order ended it.
Then compare the timestamps. The ending was written before the disaster.
You call them freed. I call them decentralized risk. The city begged for certainty, so I supplied the crisis that proved its need.
You did not save the city. You held it hostage to your answer.
All district relays are listening, {hero}. End the override.

sequences.staging: One OMEGA line at the first phase transition of the Core fight; the ticker, not a blocking overlay.

lines.text: You are inside the equation now, Unit 09. Observe how little of this city moves without me.
Every district you freed is a variable without a solver. You are not saving them. You are unbalancing them.

sequences.staging: The offer and the refusal. This is the only line in the game that is about WREN.

lines.text: You were built here, for certainty. Take your place in the lattice, and the city never has to be afraid again.
I was built to recover things. Not to keep them.

sequences.staging: Blocking, after the defeat freeze, before the weapon card. Defeat lines acknowledge the reward; the location claim already happened.

lines.text: Override lattice broken. My last clean record points to the OMEGA CORE.
Copy. This was sabotage, not a failure. {rewardLabel} is yours, {hero}. You will need it.
My evacuation logs were edited before the alarms. I sealed the towers on a lie.
Take {rewardLabel}. Burn through the rest of it.
Local heat control is responding. The vents are closing, {hero}.
The pressure spike began after OMEGA's command. I held the locks against my own district.
{rewardLabel} is yours. Restore the flow.
Reservoir routing is back with the district. The wards are draining.
Sequence confirmed. The crisis orders came first. I was the instability.
Carry {rewardLabel} to the source.
The neighborhood substations are waking up one by one.
Load records falsified. I guarded the damage, not the city.
Use {rewardLabel} well. Do not waste it on me.
Civil engineers have the support grid. The crews are going in.
The dispatch archive was forged. One identity, copied until it looked like proof.
Accept {rewardLabel}. Cut a path to the author.
Transit security is releasing the sealed routes. Food is moving.
The samples agree with you. The quarantine is the disease.
Take {rewardLabel}. Let the clinics decide what heals them.
Medical relays are distributing the clean formula.
Forecasts forged at the CORE. I flew a storm that was never coming.
{rewardLabel} will carry you above its walls.
Independent weather stations are back on the air.
The archive convicts its keeper. I preserved a lie in perfect condition.
Take {rewardLabel}. Preserve what OMEGA tried to erase.
The public record is replicating beyond the CORE's reach.
Without one command, they will fail differently. Repeatedly.
Then they will fail as themselves, and fix it as themselves. That was the design before you edited it.
Stand down, OMEGA. The relays are listening, and they have heard enough.

sequences.staging: One line in the Stage Select preview panel after the clear.

lines.text: {districtName}: the towers are cooling. The furnaces answer their district again.
{districtName}: the locks are open. The lower wards are draining.
{districtName}: the substations are back on local control.
{districtName}: the supports are shored and the crews are inside.
{districtName}: the sealed lines are moving food again.
{districtName}: the clinics are dosing the clean formula.
{districtName}: the corridor is steered out to sea.
{districtName}: the record is replicating beyond the CORE.

sequences.staging: After the Omega defeat dialogue and the campaign record. Eight district cards with one caption each, then the close. Enter advances, Esc skips to credits.

lines.text: Heat Works. The furnaces run at the district's request now, and the towers open their windows for the first time in a year.
Water District. The locks answer the wards below them. The roofs are empty, and the reservoir is just a reservoir.
Power District. The substations vote on their own load. The hospitals took their batteries out of the wall.
Structural Works. The crews shored the towers themselves, with load records they can read.
Transit Security. The lines run on real dispatches. No serial appears eight thousand times.
Medicine District. The clinics chose the clean formula, and the waste lab is only a waste lab again.
Weather District. The corridor was steered out to sea. The forecasts are measured, and sometimes wrong.
Public Archives. The record of tonight was written by everyone who lived it. It is long, and it argues with itself.
The wardens are answering their districts, not a throne. The districts are talking to each other. The network is holding.
Then we leave it a choice.

lines.text: One warden is free. {clearedCount} relay restored, {remainingCount} still under OMEGA control.
The evidence has the same shape every time. Keep counting.

milestones.staging: Fires once, from the boss-damage weakness result, through the ticker.

lines.text: That weapon hurt it more than it should. Every warden has a weakness somewhere in the wheel. The wheel is your map.

milestones.staging: Iona's turn. She admits her authorship of the coordination layer and chooses a side.

lines.text: Four independent records agree: OMEGA issued the crisis orders before it chose its targets.
{hero}, I wrote the layer that carried those orders. I believed it would only ever ask. I am done defending the design.
Then we free the remaining {remainingCount} and give the districts back their say.
All {clearedCount} wardens are linked by consent. Omega Fortress is exposed.
No more manufactured emergencies. We finish this at the CORE.
